_comment: Per-node model + inference profiles. The active profile is chosen by the TARGET_ENV env var set in the systemd units / provision/platform.env (dev=CIRRUS, beta=CUMULUS, prod=STRATUS). Code falls back to sources.json digest.ollama_model + num_ctx 8192 when TARGET_ENV is unset or the profile is missing, so CIRRUS and any pre-existing setup are unaffected. Git-tracked (NOT skip-worktree) so it flows to every node; the per-box discriminator is TARGET_ENV, not this file.

dev.note: Mac Studio 64GB. Small/fast for high-volume summarization.

beta.note: DGX Spark 121GB; cumulus2 holds the other TP=2 rank of the vLLM endpoint -- memory is NOT pooled (DGX-SPARK-PERFORMANCE.md s2). S132 (2026-09-08): digest_model was qwen3-coder:30b. Its ONE scheduled consumer, Bill's Monday ensemble draft, now drafts on the vLLM endpoint and reads this only as the fallback, so it points at the endpoint's twin -- the configured ollama_model, the model that passed the extraction gate. The 30b is removed 2026-09-14 (LOCAL-MODEL-PLAN.md Phase 1 step 4).

prod.note: Production (future). 480B MoE needs the 256GB pooled tier + vLLM. Placeholder until STRATUS is provisioned.
